question: Which of the following methods of particle size reduction in a powder mixture get smaller size ranges ?:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Cutting methods -> smaller particle size ranges -> 80% CHAIN: Compression methods -> variable particle size ranges -> 70% CHAIN: Impact methods -> smaller particle size ranges -> 75% CHAIN: Methods of friction -> variable particle size ranges -> 80%
analysis: When it comes to particle size reduction in a powder mixture, impact methods are known to be effective in achieving smaller size ranges. Impact methods involve the use of force or energy to break down particles into smaller sizes.
